newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Food Lion started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Food Lion started.

text.p: -- JP Morgan said it initiated coverage of Food Lion Inc with a market performer rating.
-- said there is danger that same-store sales may fall back to about a three percent rise during 1997.
-- It said Food Lion is building sub-40,000-square-feet stores and may be forced to change that format if competitors' store sizes become more popular.
-- said discontinuation of the old Kash N' Karry promotional platform is causing sales weakness.
-- Food Lion was up 1/16 to 8 in morning trading.
-- Food Lion is a unit of the Belgian retailer Ets Delhaize Freres et Cie "LE LION" SA.
